title: Prime Minister congratulates Naorem Roshibina Devi on winning Silver Medal in Women’s Sanda 60kg event
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Naorem Roshibina Devi on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s Sanda 60kg event.
The Prime Minister stated that winning medals in three consecutive Asian Games is a noteworthy achievement. He noted that her consistency, courage, and determination are truly commendable. Shri Modi further extended his best wishes to her for all future endeavours.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"Congratulations to Naorem Roshibina Devi on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s Sanda 60kg event. This is a noteworthy achievement…winning medals in 3 consecutive Asian Games. Her consistency, courage and determination are truly commendable.
Best wishes for all future endeavours: PM @narendramodi"
